fields.description: Master switch. With this off, no agent run can start anywhere in the site.
fields.label: Enable Sales AI

fields.description: Used when a request does not name an agent.
fields.label: Default Agent Profile

fields.description: Lets Sales AI Triggers start runs on their own. A second switch on purpose: turning Sales AI on should not also let it act unattended.
fields.label: Enable Triggers

fields.description: Most records one run may change. Once reached, further changes are refused and the agent is told, so it finishes and explains itself instead of stopping mid-task. Empty means no cap.
fields.label: Max Writes Per Run

fields.description: Most tokens one user may spend in a day, across every run they start or that runs as them. Empty means no budget.
fields.label: Daily Token Budget Per User
